narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed full-year FY26 PAT reached Rs 2,497 crores, closely matching reported Mar 2026 annual PAT of Rs 2,487.0 crores.
Management claimed Q1 FY27 revenue reached Rs 1,707 crores, whereas reported Jun 2026 revenue was Rs 1,566.0 crores.
Management claimed operating EBITDA margins expanded to 64% in FY26; reported Mar 2026 EBITDA margin was 68.0%.

bull: Annual revenue surged from Rs 3,212.0 crores in Mar 2025 to Rs 5,124.0 crores in Mar 2026.
EBITDA margin expanded to 68.0% in Mar 2026, supported by 3,400 bps operating margin expansion over 3 years.
Free cash flow reached Rs 2,589.0 crores in Mar 2026 with zero borrowings across all reported periods.
bear: Quarterly revenue fell 8.5% sequentially from Rs 1,566.0 crores in Jun 2026 to Rs 1,433.0 crores in Sep 2026.
Net profit declined 7.4% quarter-on-quarter from Rs 873.0 crores in Jun 2026 to Rs 808.0 crores in Sep 2026.
Operating cash flow dropped from Rs 2,643.0 crores in Mar 2024 to Rs 414.0 crores in Mar 2025.
watch: Quarterly revenue recovery from Sep 2026 level of Rs 1,433.0 crores.
Cash market share progress toward double-digit target by calendar year 2027.
Co-location capacity utilization relative to the 500 installed racks.
